items.title: 8.2 Cultural and Ethical Implications of AI Systems

source_refs.note: Topic 8.2 as printed: the text before its first sub-heading (PDF 112-113, printed 108-109).

blocks.text: Artificial Intelligence (AI) influences how people live, work, and interact with technology, making it essential to consider its cultural and ethical effects. AI systems are not only technical creations but also social tools that impact individuals, communities, and governments. (as shown in Figure 8.5).

blocks.alt: A pictorial figure with no labels: an AI brain with circuit lines in the centre, with scales of justice below left and a judge's gavel below right. Stakeholders stand around it: a man with glasses behind the brain, a woman and a girl on the left, a woman in a hijab and an elderly bearded man on the right, and a person icon and a government-building icon at the top.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.5: Ethical AI Design Balances the Interests of Different Stakeholders While Ensuring Fairness and Inclusivity. (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 8.5)
blocks.long_description: No text appears in the figure; the people on both sides reach towards the AI brain.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Debate: “Should AI make decisions that affect people's lives, such as job hiring or grading students?”
